name: mPower Subscription & Recurring Payment Solution
long_description:
The mPower Subscription and Recurring Payment Solution is a native subscription management solution for the Magento 2 platform (no separate account needed). mPower enables Magento merchants to leverage the recurring revenue business model within the Magento platform. Running your subscription business becomes a breeze with intuitive automation options that you can’t find anywhere else.

PowerSync designed mPower to grow with your subscription-based businesses and to eliminate the need to invest in a custom solution. The solution also comes with 24/7 support for the first year, and it can be renewed thereafter.

Just like any good subscription business, PowerSync wants to keep our customers on board for life! The mPower Subscription and Recurring Payment extension was designed to keep your customers happy, fulfilled, and loyal to your brand (effortlessly), starting with the basic functionality that you would expect from any other subscription management software:

  • Easily accept recurring payments
  • Manage subscription products
  • Manage recurring customer profiles 
  • Report on high-level business outcomes
  • Dive into precise customer order details and preferences
  • Easily modify customer preferences
  • Allow buyers to self-service their recurring orders
  • Infinite configuration options to accommodate any business model
  • A simple checkout experience for regular and recurring orders
  • Automatic merchant and customer notifications 

Enjoy the most comprehensive solution for recurring transactions, subscription products, and memberships. Furthermore, our active US-based product team is constantly working to improve the product and customer experience. 

 

Pricing

mPower is available for Magento Open Source, Magento Commerce, and Magento Commerce Cloud. The advertised cost is an annual cost of the extension which also includes Standard Support. Other Support tiers are available upon request. One-time installation and setup options are available as well and those start at $1,400.

 

Joining our product family, you get updates and support from our team for life: 

  • 24/7 US-based Customer Support
  • Hands-on, White Glove Service (upon request)
  • Comprehensive User Guides
  • Free Lifetime Updates

 

Features:

  • Create Custom Billing Frequencies
  • Automate Recurring Transactions
  • Manage Trials and Expirations
  • Automate Subscription Renewals
  • Receive past due payment and card expiration notifications
  • View customer account history, subscription products, and preferences
  • Make mass price changes across different subscription terms
  • Group products based on subscription terms and longevity
  • Payment Gateway Integrations: Braintree, PayFlow Pro, Stripe, Authorize.Net CIM, CyberSource, and more 
  • Supports Magento Catalog and Shopping Cart price rules
  • Works natively with Amasty One-page Checkout
  • Renewal notifications and reminders

 

Built-in Reporting Options:

  • By Product
  • By Frequency
  • By Customer

 

Available Fee Schedules:

  • Trial periods; paid or free options available
  • One-time initiation fees; charged to new accounts, by product
  • Customizable, exclusive offers that can extend for customer lifecycle 
  • Per iteration; charged every time product or service is delivered or shipped

 

Available Billing Cycles:

  • Monthly, Semi-Annual, Annual, and other custom Billing Cycles
  • Limited and Unlimited Subscription Periods
  • One Time Charges or Recurring Transactions, by product 

 

Customer Views & Testimonials

Your success is our #1 priority!  Whether you are launching a membership site, a new subscription-based business, diversifying your product portfolio, adding a recurring revenue stream, or simply looking to enhance your existing business, mPower is the right option for you.
